medium: architectural history: neon-outline diagrams on black, 3D building renders, desert geometry diagrams, papyrus illustrations, cut into a studio talking head
avoid: flat cartoon, stick figures, photography of people, gradients on flat panels, glossy stock imagery, legible text
note: Her on camera and the meme/film cutaways are non-generatable. Five generatable looks from the sheets. Recut 2026-09-14 with the corrected frame timing; neon picks re-read from sheet 0 (12 frames); split frames cropped to the graphic above the presenter.

looks.label: Presenter in studio
looks.when: the creator on camera — never generated.

looks.label: Neon-outline diagram on black
looks.when: a system, a sequence, a comparison, a quantity — explained as a glowing diagram.
looks.prompt: A technical diagram on pure black: thin glowing neon outlines in hot pink, orange and white — simple shapes (triangles for structures, boxes for stages), connected by thin bright lines and small arrows, a faint grid, small labels as illegible marks, a soft glow around every line. Nothing else in frame.

looks.label: 3D architectural render
looks.when: a building, a city, a monument — shown as a lit 3D model, often from above or a low dramatic angle.
looks.prompt: A cinematic 3D render of an ancient structure — a Roman amphitheatre, a pyramid, a colonnade — in warm stone tones under dramatic low light, tiny figures for scale, dust and haze in the air, clean geometry, photoreal materials.

looks.label: Gold geometry on black
looks.when: a shape, an angle, a proportion — the abstract form of a structure isolated and lit.
looks.prompt: A single luminous geometric form — a pyramid, a nested square, a ramp — rendered in glowing gold on pure black, soft light bloom, seen slightly from above, nothing else in frame.

looks.label: Measured diagram on sand
looks.when: dimensions, angles, footprints, distances — a measurement drawn over the real ground.
looks.prompt: A warm orange-sand landscape seen from above with a thin white measurement diagram drawn over it — a triangle with an angle marked, a footprint outlined with an area label as illegible marks, a compass rose — technical lines over natural ground.

looks.label: Egyptian papyrus illustration
looks.when: the ancient world's own record — figures, boats, plants — as painted on papyrus or a tomb wall.
looks.prompt: An ancient Egyptian painting in the flat profile style of tomb walls and papyrus: figures in profile with linear limbs, ochre, rust, black and cream, hieroglyph-like marks as illegible symbols, aged texture, a boat or reeds or workers.
